text: This report recommends the appointment of four public members to the Heritage Toronto Board of Directors.

City Council on December 13, 14, and 15, 2023, adopted the following: 1. City Council appoint the following candidates to the Heritage Toronto Board of Directors, at pleasure of Council, for a term of office ending on December 15, 2027, and until successors are appointed: James Lane Melissa Nugegoda Harmeet Singh Sandhu Hana Syed 2. City Council direct that the balance of Confidential Attachment 1 and the entirety of Confidential Attachment 2 remain confidential as they relate to personal matters about identifiable individuals being considered for appointment to the Heritage Toronto Board of Directors.
